title: Jump-Ball Tip Play
description: A taller player tips a simulated opening jump ball to a specific teammate's spot, practising a coordinated start-of-game or start-of-overtime routine.

content.objective: Coordinate a tipped jump ball to land with a specific teammate rather than leaving it to chance.
content.setup: A tosser lightly tosses the ball up between two jumpers at the top of the key; a designated receiver waits nearby.
instructions: The jumper tips the ball with control toward the pre-called receiver's spot.
The receiver times their movement to arrive exactly as the ball does.
Catch and immediately pivot to protect the ball from any nearby defender.
Reset and repeat with a different called receiver each time.
coachingPoints: Tip with control and placement, not just height.
The receiver should move to the ball, not wait for it to come directly to them.
Call the intended receiver out loud before the toss so everyone knows the plan.
commonMistakes: Tipping the ball randomly instead of toward the called spot.
Receiver standing still and letting the ball bounce away untouched.
Losing focus on the details once the simulated pressure is on.
content.safety: Toss the ball with light, controlled height — this is a simulation, not a contested jump.
